shots.title: Kostas Kneels
shots.video_prompt: Kostas kneels in wet stone and low fog, furious and afraid, looking up from below. The Flame Emperor stands above him in the red horned mask and black-red cloak, calm and dominant. Torchlight flickers against ruins and armor. The power relationship is clear: Kostas is disposable, the masked figure is in control.
